body: Owner report, 13 Nov 2026 (relayed): searching 'jinjer', spelled right, puts a song first and not the band, although the band is what he meant. He wants a way to prefer a band when its name is written correctly and it is popular, over its songs ('we need a way of judging'). Related: a letter or two wrong is N-23; the top result's missing buttons are N-21.
